note: Closed variety of the run record, read ONLY through driver_journal.run_record. run_classes: the values STORY_RUN_CLASS may carry besides the default (a run that sets nothing is live; a value not listed here is unknown, never live). resume_kinds: the ROAD of a resumed role row (`resume_kind` of driver-runs.jsonl), one token per road, never a class of the refusal text; a caller that names none, or a token not listed here, is unclassified.
